purpose: Teach: 各人/個々人/同国/番手/会期/座談/顔面/おこなう

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 各人の役割を明確にしましょう
lines.en: Let's clarify each person's role in this.
lines.style: Businesslike, clear. Opens with quiet authority. Steady pace, no filler. Lands each word with purpose. The tone of someone used to being listened to.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。個々人の意見を集約します
lines.style: Alert, collaborative. Quick agreement with a hint of eagerness to move forward. Respectful nod in the voice. Steady, capable—not performing, just committing.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 同国の市場規模を把握しましょう
lines.en: We should also get a clear picture of the market size in that region.
lines.style: Measured instruction. Open the thought cleanly, then settle into explanation. Matter-of-fact but not cold. The voice of someone thinking out loud with her team.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業界番手としての責任を意識します
lines.en: Understood. I'll make sure we're mindful of our position as an industry leader.
lines.style: Affirmation with quiet conviction. Lean slightly forward in the voice. Not mechanical—he's already turning it over in his mind, already owning it.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 会期中の対応シフトを組みましょう
lines.en: And we'll need to plan a shift rotation for the duration of the conference.
lines.style: Light but decisive. She's moving the meeting forward. Not demanding—inviting collaboration, but with clear direction. Almost conversational in rhythm.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内座談会を月一で開催します
lines.en: Got it. We'll set up monthly all-hands meetings to keep everyone aligned.
lines.style: Quick, affirmative. He's already planning as he speaks. Efficient but warm—not rattling off orders, laying out next steps he believes in.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: プレゼンの顔面表情も大事ね
lines.en: And remember—how we present ourselves matters. Even our expressions.
lines.style: Thoughtful note, almost gentle. She's not micromanaging—she's offering wisdom from experience. Warm undertone, like she cares about their success.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。研修を毎月おこなう仕組みを作ります
lines.en: Absolutely. I'll build a structure for monthly training so we can refine our delivery.
lines.style: Resolute closing note. He's gathered everything she's said and is synthesizing it into action. Firm but not heavy. The final word lands with quiet confidence.
